dialogues.speaker: Sedzimir
dialogues.text: Hmm... I'd better get me some Alpacas! Once they've hauled everything over to Snezhnaya, I can make a little extra by selling their wool.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Won't they get cold without their coats?

dialogues.speaker: Sedzimir
dialogues.text: Hmm... You make a good point. If they grow such thick and fluffy coats even in sunny Natlan, they'll probably end up getting ill walking around Snezhnaya au naturel...

dialogues.speaker: Sedzimir
dialogues.text: If the flu gets 'em while we're on the road... Well, the losses would be too great to bear! Looking at it that way, maybe Sumpter Beasts would be the better option? It's a difficult choice to make.

dialogues.speaker: Sedzimir
dialogues.text: Alright then... Should I buy a Desert Sumpter Beast or an Alpaca? I was hoping to hear your thoughts.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You could always try not shaving them...

dialogues.speaker: Sedzimir
dialogues.text: Huh... That's not a bad idea. And if I don't shave them, I can bury myself in a big fluffy Alpaca bundle out on the road and save myself some money on a winter coat...

dialogues.speaker: Sedzimir
dialogues.text: That said, Sumpter Beasts can carry more goods than Alpacas, so I'll make more money in the end to offset the price of a coat... Ooh, it's so hard to choose!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (<color=#FFCC33FF>Jahoda</color> appears to have something on her mind...)

dialogues.speaker: Sedzimir
dialogues.text: Miss Jahoda! About the shortcut I asked you to look for the last time... Do we have any news yet?

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: No, no, not yet. This is quite a complicated problem, and it will take quite some time, I'm afraid.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: (Hmph, how could I possibly share such intel with you? I'd have cashed in on it on my own a long time ago...)

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: (Wait, no, that's not right. I'd have cashed in with Boss Nef and Ashru, obviously!)

dialogues.speaker: Sedzimir
dialogues.text: It's alright, I understand. Please, you must find it, I'm counting on you!

dialogues.speaker: Sedzimir
dialogues.text: Once we find that path, I'll make a huge profit for sure...
